title.zh: Baseten一周改造千问：27B决策模型登顶，9B超过Jev
title.en: Baseten一周改造千问：27B决策模型登顶，9B超过Jev

current_state.zh: Baseten's Base Labs released MIT-licensed mammoth-1 (27B) and elephant-1 (9B) decision models, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5 in one week, with mammoth-1 topping the Jev Decision Index and elephant-1 leading sub-15B models.
